policy: Proposed 2027 subscription prices. Preferred EUR list prices per user/month for 1–6 apps: €27, €51, €72, €91, €107 and €134. Early adopter EUR prices are exactly 20% lower for eligible subscriptions from January to March 2027, first 12 months. Previously proposed DKK listed monthly amounts remain 200, 380, 540, 680, 800 and 1000; the six-app early adopter DKK price remains 800. USD display uses dated ECB EUR/USD rate. Organisation discount rules remain separate and do not stack with early adopter rates. Trial, subscription provisioning and payment checkout are not yet active.

referenceConversion.note: EUR normal prices are the preferred rounded whole-euro list amounts, selected to be nearest to existing DKK normal prices. USD display values are EUR times the dated EUR/USD reference rate. DKK listed amounts stay at their previously proposed values; there is no live FX conversion or checkout.
